segments.captionText: A script supervisor decides one thing at the end of a shoot day: is this scene safe to wrap. segments.captionText: LastTake checks every required beat against the takes actually captured before the crew is released, so a missing shot costs minutes, not a pickup day. It decides nothing: absent evidence is a finding, never a pass. Live, no account, open source. Walk the shoot day yourself.
